meta.title: The Forgotten Temple
meta.description: You are trapped in a cursed ancient temple. A malevolent enchantment drives a ten-minute countdown — when it expires the stone chamber resets, erasing your progress. Solve the mechanisms, combine the relics, and escape before the curse reclaims you.

onTimerEnd.message: The ancient curse completes its cycle. The chamber rumbles and resets…

rooms.name: Entrance Hall
rooms.description: Dust-choked light falls through cracks in the ceiling. Carved serpents coil around every pillar. The air smells of old stone and something metallic. A sealed arch looms to the north; a dark passage leads east.

rooms.name: Chamber of Mirrors
rooms.description: Three bronze mirrors stand on stone pedestals, each slightly angled. When aligned correctly they should focus a beam of light onto the carved eye above the northern door. The exit to the sanctum lies beyond that eye.

rooms.name: Altar Room
rooms.description: A cracked altar dominates the room. Stone sconces hold unlit torches. An inscription reads: "Light feeds the stone; the staff awaits the sun." A locked iron gate bars the way to the reliquary.

actions.label: Light the Sconces
actions.description: Use your torch to light the altar sconces.
actions.failMessage: You need a light source to ignite the sconces.

effects.name: sconces-lit
effects.message: The sconces blaze to life, bathing the altar in warm orange light.

actions.successMessage: Golden light fills the altar room.

rooms.name: The Reliquary
rooms.description: A circular chamber. At its centre stands a stone pedestal with a star-shaped socket. The exit — a massive iron door engraved with solar symbols — is sealed by a mechanism that demands a charged relic. This is the way out.

items.name: Sun Disc
items.description: A flat disc of hammered gold, etched with radiating lines. It fits in the palm of your hand.
items.examineText: One face bears the symbol of a rising sun; the other has a slot that might accept a staff fitting.

items.name: Unlit Torch
items.description: A pitch-soaked torch. It needs a flame to be useful.
items.examineText: Standard temple torch — pitch-sealed reed wrapped in cloth. It will burn for a good while once lit.

flint-shard.message: You strike the flint against the torch head. It catches with a warm crack.

items.name: Flint Shard
items.description: A sharp chip of dark flint, useful for striking sparks.
items.examineText: Knapped to a fine edge. Good for making fire.

items.name: Lit Torch
items.description: A blazing torch. It lights your way and ignites whatever needs burning.
items.examineText: The flame burns steadily, casting dancing shadows across carved stone walls.
items.useText: You hold the torch aloft — it illuminates the area but needs a specific target to be useful.

items.name: Ancient Staff
items.description: A carved wooden staff banded with tarnished copper. One end has a hollow socket.
items.examineText: The socket at the top is exactly the right size to seat a disc or medallion.

sun-disc.message: You press the sun disc into the staff's socket. It clicks home with a resonant hum — the copper bands glow faintly.

items.name: Charged Staff
items.description: The ancient staff crowned with the sun disc. It pulses with restrained energy.
items.examineText: The combined relic hums in your grip. Solar symbols across the disc glow with a steady golden light.

useEffects.name: staff-used-on-pedestal
useEffects.message: You drive the charged staff into the pedestal socket. The room shudders.

items.useText: The staff radiates warmth. It is meant for the star-shaped pedestal in the reliquary.

items.name: Bronze Key
items.description: A heavy bronze key with serpentine scrollwork on the bow.
items.examineText: It matches the iron gate lock leading to the reliquary.

useEffects.name: reliquary-gate-open
useEffects.message: The bronze key turns in the iron gate with a satisfying clunk. The gate swings open.

hints.text: The serpent lock responds to light. Find a way to illuminate it — something in the entrance hall can help you start a fire.
The mirrors must be adjusted in sequence: left first, then centre, then right. Each adjustment narrows the beam toward the carved eye.
The star-shaped socket in the reliquary accepts a charged relic. Combine the sun disc with the ancient staff, then use the result on the pedestal.

events.name: Serpent Lock
events.description: A stone panel carved with two coiled serpents blocks the northern arch. Their eyes are hollow — sockets for some missing light source.

steps.description: Retrieve the flint shard from the base of the east pillar.

effects.message: You pry a flint shard from the mortar at the pillar's base.

steps.description: Combine the flint shard with the unlit torch to make a light source.

action.label: Strike Flint to Torch
action.failMessage: You need the flint shard first.

steps.description: Hold the lit torch to the serpents' eye sockets to trigger the mechanism.

action.label: Illuminate the Serpents
action.failMessage: You need a lit torch to trigger the serpent lock.

onComplete.name: north-arch-open
onComplete.message: The serpents' eyes ignite with golden fire. With a grinding rumble the stone arch slides open, revealing the mirror chamber beyond.

events.name: Mirror Alignment
events.description: Three bronze mirrors on pedestals must be rotated in the correct sequence to focus a beam of light onto the carved eye above the sanctum door.

steps.description: Rotate the left mirror to angle the light inward.

effects.name: mirror-left-set
effects.message: The left mirror swings with a metallic groan. A thin beam of light appears.

steps.description: Rotate the centre mirror to redirect the beam upward.

action.label: Rotate Centre Mirror
action.failMessage: The centre mirror must follow the left one.

effects.name: mirror-centre-set
effects.message: The centre mirror catches the beam and bends it sharply upward.

steps.description: Rotate the right mirror to aim the converged beam at the carved eye.

onComplete.name: sanctum-door-open
onComplete.message: Three beams merge into one blazing column. The carved eye above the door blazes to life — and the sanctum door grinds open.

events.name: Star Pedestal
events.description: A stone pedestal with a star-shaped socket dominates the reliquary's centre. Carved text reads: 'The sun-bearer opens the solar door.'

steps.description: Place the charged staff into the star-shaped socket.

action.label: Insert Charged Staff
action.failMessage: The socket demands the sun disc mounted on the ancient staff. You do not have it.

effects.name: staff-inserted
effects.message: The charged staff slides into the socket with a resonant chime. The floor trembles.

steps.description: Activate the solar mechanism to unseal the iron door.

action.label: Activate Solar Mechanism
action.failMessage: The pedestal needs the charged staff first.

steps.description: Push open the iron door and walk free.

endings.title: Escaped!
endings.text: You burst through the iron door into blinding daylight. Behind you the temple groans as its curse, deprived of a victim, collapses inward. You made it. The forgotten temple is forgotten once more — this time, without you inside it.

endings.title: The Curse Resets
endings.text: The countdown reaches zero. The stone floor dissolves beneath your feet, the torchlight snuffs out, and when the light returns everything is as it was. The temple begins again — and so, it seems, do you.
